newsitem.title: UK: Weaker US cotton futures revive Europe markets.
newsitem.headline: Weaker US cotton futures revive Europe markets.

text.p: Lower New York futures fuelled new mill buyer interest in taking up a range of upland cottons to cover both nearby and distant shipment needs.
Few Central Asian offers were seen, turning attention to Mediterranean growths harvested in early autumn and, in some markets, to African styles.
Market participants think that many spinners still need cotton for September/December shipment onwards. - - London Newsroom +44 171 542 7729
